newsitem.title: UK: Invesco says may bid for Saracen.
newsitem.headline: Invesco says may bid for Saracen.

text.p: Invesco Asset Management said on Friday it could bid for Saracen Value Trust plc in the near future.
"Invesco may in the near future submit proposals to the board of Saracen which may or may not lead to an offer being made for the entire issued share capital of Saracen," Invesco said in a statement.
Saracen has been the subject of a management takeover bid from HSBC Investment Management.
Invesco said it had followed events affecting Saracen "since Saracen received an unsolicited approach from HSBC Asset Management to change the investment management arrangements for the company".
It had also noted speculation of Invesco's potential involvement with Saracen.
"In common with other management groups, Invesco is considering whether it can be of assistance to Saracen," the statement said.
Saracen said on Tuesday it has been approached by firms other than HSBC and it wanted time to asses the alternatives.
"We are not convinced that HSBC is the best solution for our shareholders. There are better solutions for Saracen shareholders and we need time to assess," SFM fund manager Jim Fisher told Reuters.
He said alternative solutions included a restructuring of the trust, returning cash to shareholders, or employing other managers.
HSBC has said it wanted to replace SFM Investment Management as the fund manager of the 81 million sterling trust.
Saracen shares were bid at Thursday's 96 pence closing price at 1300 GMT.
